productOnPage.descriptionHtml:
Dive into the thrilling world of international espionage with The Kensy and Max Collection: Volume 1! This action-packed box set features the first five captivating books in the series, each brimming with mystery, adventure, and unexpected twists.


Kensy and Max 1: Breaking News Twins Kensy and Max Grey are thrust into a world of secrets when they’re whisked away to London after their parents mysteriously vanish. Strange schools, coded messages, and mysterious neighbors set the stage for a quest to uncover the truth.


Kensy and Max 2: Disappearing Act Now agents-in-training at the covert spy network Pharos, Kensy and Max face their first challenge in Rome. What starts as a school trip quickly turns into a dangerous mission involving Mafia secrets and a runaway boy.


Kensy and Max 3: Undercover On an undercover assignment in Sydney, the twins must navigate the secrets of an elite school. As they dig deeper, the stakes grow higher, and the hunt for their parents intensifies.


Kensy and Max 4: Out of Sight Juggling their studies and the spy life, Kensy and Max are swept into another whirlwind adventure. When journalists go missing and stolen treasures lead to Paris, the twins must race against time to solve the mystery.


Kensy and Max 5: Freefall What begins as a family trip to New York quickly transforms into a high-stakes pursuit of dangerous criminals. With their friends and family at risk, Kensy and Max must break the rules to protect those they love.


Perfect for fans of mystery, intrigue, and fast-paced adventures, The Kensy and Max Collection: Volume 1 is the ultimate introduction to a series that will keep readers on the edge of their seats.
